parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is a switch handle of the faucet made of stainless steel, used to control water flow.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the flow rate.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or lifts to open and close the water valve.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another switch handle of the faucet made of stainless steel, typically used to control water temperature or flow from a different source.
parts.Functional_description: It regulates either hot or cold water flow depending on the faucet design.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or lifts to adjust the water temperature or flow.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body or frame of the faucet made of brass, providing structural support and housing for internal water channels.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the water supply lines and supports the switches and spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the base for other moving parts.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water from the faucet body to the sink or basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water flow in different directions.
